# layout

The tab bar is opt-in (no `Apps.TabBar` contributor ⇒ no strip) and the rail is
a contributed framing variant. An **embedded document** — one opened with
`?embed=1`, see `primitives/embed` — takes both chrome-less paths regardless of
what is contributed or configured: no tab bar, and the railless framing.

## Plugin reference

- Description: Apps layout: the Core.Root composition wiring the tab bar, rail framing, and surface together, with the default-app redirect and document-title sync.
- Load-bearing: yes
- Web:
  - Contributes: `Core.Root` → `AppsLayout`
  - Uses:
    - `apps-core.Apps`
    - `apps-core.defaultApp`
    - `apps-core.matchAppForPath`

    - `primitives/css/badge.Badge`
    - `primitives/css/center.Center`
    - `primitives/css/spacing.Stack`
